applicant_utility.summary: This is Turin's flagship merit scholarship for non-Italian, non-resident applicants to English-taught master's programmes: EUR 20,000 gross over two years plus a tuition-fee waiver that still leaves the first instalment to pay. There is no scholarship form at all - your ordinary apply.unito.it application is the scholarship application, so every admission document doubles as scholarship evidence and must be complete the first time. With only two awards per programme across roughly twenty eligible courses, strength within your specific programme matters more than raw CV quality. The 2026-2027 round is closed, but the late-November to end-of-January window with May rankings is a reliable template for the next edition.

applicant_utility.summary: This corridor scholarship is built for recognised refugees in thirteen African and Asian countries and pays EUR 7,000 gross per year on top of fee exemption, University-arranged accommodation and an unusually deep support package covering food, transport, insurance and paperwork. Applications go through the UNICORE portal only, and the file lives or dies on document quality: stamped and signed originals, correct translations and legible PDFs. Selection is a two-stage process of scored documentation plus an online interview, with refugee status re-verified by UNHCR on site before interviews. The 2026/2027-2027/2028 edition closed on 17 April 2026, so the practical use of this record is preparation for the next edition.
